title: Pura Vida y ecoturismo: Del modelo extractivo a la conservación
goal: Explain Costa Rica's green energy matrix, the Payment for Environmental Services (PSA) program, and the cultural philosophy of 'Pura Vida'.
grammar: Léxico de ecoturismo, matriz energética y regeneración ambiental

sections.title: Unit 7: Costa Rica — Lesson 4
body: Welcome to lesson 4 of Unit 7 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Costa Rica: Demilitarization, Biodiversity & Democratic Welfare.
In this lesson, we explore pura vida y ecoturismo: del modelo extractivo a la conservación, examining the country's environmental, civic, and economic models.

items: Explain Costa Rica's green energy matrix, the Payment for Environmental Services (PSA) program, and the cultural philosophy of 'Pura Vida'.
Master the terminology and syntax of ecoturismo-matriz-energetica.
Deploy advanced socio-environmental vocabulary (el servicio ambiental, la descarbonización).
